title: Moneten extension manifest
description: The manifest.json of a catalog package. Moneten lets the package contact only the hosts listed here and asks for exactly the login fields listed here.

id.description: The name of the package folder under extensions/. It never changes.

name.description: The name that the Extensions window shows.

version.description: The package version, such as 2.31. Every change to a file of the package needs a higher version.

description.description: One sentence that says what the extension fetches.

files.description: The Lua files of the package in load order.

hosts.description: Every host the extension contacts, as an exact lowercase name. No wildcards, ports, schemes, or IP addresses.

services.description: The services that the script registers in WebBanking{services=...}, each with the labels of its login fields in the order the script receives them.

login.description: At most four fields. A field with secret true is typed without showing the characters.

kinds.description: The kinds of data the extension fetches.

apiVersion.description: The lowest value of MM.apiVersion the extension needs.

license.description: The SPDX identifier of the license in the LICENSE file. Only GPL-compatible open source licenses are allowed.

maintainer.description: The person who answers failure reports for the package.
